scope: Pure source-best M lease engineering only; CPU temporary/toy evidence, no real GPU/native context, original owner, original phase lock or F changes. No production bridge approval.

original_findings_disposition.evidence: Owner PID/start, nonce creation and phase check now share the exception-cleanup boundary. Independent _start and uuid4 fault injections both clear phase.fd and permit immediate independent acquisition of the temporary original-named phase lock.

PDEATHSIG now uses unignorable SIGKILL while retaining direct-parent/start-tick checks before and after setup. A temporary worker explicitly ignoring SIGTERM entered mocked native_gpu, then stopped after its owner exited0. Both its inherited phase lock and mock native GPU lock became available without any control-pipe exit request or existing-PID signal.

independent_temporary_probes.method: Temporary directories and CPU subprocesses only. Native inventory was replaced by mock strings, not queried. Owner exit was requested normally through stdin; fallback pipe was not needed to stop the SIGKILL-armed worker. Protected-index and nonoriginal-parent probes were bounded and all directly owned subprocesses were waited.

initial_review_RED.interpretation: Real _start/nonce initialization failures. The initial parent-death case had an inherited-pipe fixture timeout and is not treated as the decisive parent-death RED.

corrected_parent_death_RED.interpretation: Corrected fixture:1failed17deselected, orphan ignored death cleanup after owner exit.

preserved_lease_boundaries: Owner exit still closes without LOCK_UN; passing inherited-FD retention regression demonstrates phase remains held while an inherited child description is alive.

Original phase/native lock name contention, duplicate supervisor/worker refusal, empty regular/single-link canonical-file checks, symlink/nonempty preservation, owner-FD loss and independently-opened same-inode rejection remain covered by the passing18-case suite.

Independent additional grandchild probes reject the original-owner proof when direct parent differs and reject a forged intermediary-owner proof when kernel FLOCK attribution remains with the original owner.
Selected native UUID must map to physical index0-3 before native-file creation and again under lock; busy/memory guards remain. Mock indices4,5,6,7 all reject before creating native lock paths.
The native descriptor remains inside try/finally; default worker ownership and phase checks remain unchanged. These are cooperative-lock semantics, not authority to execute any real job.
integration_boundaries: A future owner/worker bridge still requires its own code/proof/permit/job/resource review. The pure lease is not a source-best selection permit, scientific gate or GPU launch approval.
Busy inventory is an observation supplementing shared kernel locks; no claim is made against unrelated launchers ignoring the protocol or unrestricted hostile pathname mutation.
PDEATHSIG is Linux parent-thread behavior; future launching code should keep the creating owner thread alive through its children. This report does not measure real CUDA teardown latency.
